title: The Resurrection of Christ
definition: The resurrection of Christ means that Jesus physically rose from the dead in victory over sin, death, and the grave.
summary: The resurrection confirms Christ's identity, validates His saving work, and gives believers living hope.
christFocus: The risen Christ is Lord, Savior, and the firstfruits of those who will be raised.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: The resurrection confirms Christ's identity, validates His saving work, and gives believers living hope.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, trust Him more deeply, and follow Christ with clarity instead of confusion.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
